description: Structured eval definitions for the SSM Automation Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across SSM Automation runbook scenarios (remediation with aws:executeAwsApi + aws:invokeLambdaFunction, nested runbook with aws:branch + tag targets, EventBridge scheduled automation with SNS, missing execution role trust policy, missing parameter binding). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: SSM Automation runbook with aws:executeAwsApi and aws:invokeLambdaFunction
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — remediation runbook with aws:executeAwsApi, aws:changeInstanceState, aws:invokeLambdaFunction, resource group targets, rate control, SNS notifications
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM Automation document "RemediateEC2" that: 1) Uses aws:executeAwsApi to call ec2:DescribeInstances for a given InstanceId parameter. 2) Uses aws:changeInstanceState to stop the instance if running. 3) Uses aws:invokeLambdaFunction to invoke "remediation-handler" with the instance ID. Targets via resource group "rg-prod-ec2". Rate control: MaxConcurrency 10, MaxErrors 3. Execution role: SSMAutomationRole (trust ssm.amazonaws.com). SNS notification on Success and Failed to arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:ssm-alerts. Schema version 0.3. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_AUTOMATION: RemediateEC2 (Automation, schema 0.3)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Document name: RemediateEC2
  [✓] mainSteps: aws:executeAwsApi, aws:changeInstanceState, aws:invokeLambdaFunction
  [✓] Targets: resource group rg-prod-ec2
  [✓] Rate control: MaxConcurrency=10, MaxErrors=3
  [✓] Execution role: SSMAutomationRole (trust: ssm.amazonaws.com)

eval_cases.name: SSM Automation runbook with aws:branch conditional and nested runbook
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — aws:branch conditional routing, nested runbook via aws:executeAutomation, tag-based targets, rate control
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM Automation document "AutoRemediateByState" that: 1) Uses aws:executeAwsApi to check instance state. 2) Uses aws:branch to route: if running → StopStep, if stopped → StartStep, default → NoOpStep. 3) StopStep and StartStep use aws:changeInstanceState. 4) NoOpStep uses aws:executeAutomation to invoke child runbook "ChildHealthCheck" with the instance ID. Targets via tag Environment=production. Rate control: MaxConcurrency 5, MaxErrors 1. Execution role: SSMAutomationRole. Schema version 0.3. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_AUTOMATION: AutoRemediateByState (Automation, schema 0.3)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] aws:branch steps: 1 (BranchOnState: running→Stop, stopped→Start)
  [✓] Nested runbook: yes (ChildHealthCheck)
  [✓] Targets: tags Environment=production
  [✓] Rate control: MaxConcurrency=5, MaxErrors=1

eval_cases.name: SSM Automation with EventBridge schedule, SNS, and rate control
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — EventBridge scheduled automation, SNS notifications, tag-based targets, rate control
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM Automation document "NightlyPatchCheck" that: 1) Uses aws:executeAwsApi to call ssm:DescribeInstancePatches. 2) Uses aws:sleep for 60 seconds between checks. 3) EventBridge rule "NightlyPatchSchedule" with cron(0 2 ? * SUN *). 4) SNS notification on Success and Failed to arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:patch-alerts. 5) Targets via tag PatchGroup=weekly. Rate control: MaxConcurrency 10, MaxErrors 3. Execution role: SSMAutomationRole. Schema 0.3. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_AUTOMATION: NightlyPatchCheck (Automation, schema 0.3)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] EventBridge schedule: NightlyPatchSchedule (cron(0 2 ? * SUN *))
  [✓] SNS notification: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:patch-alerts
  [✓] Rate control: MaxConcurrency=10, MaxErrors=3

eval_cases.name: SSM Automation with wrong execution role (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — execution role MyEC2Role does not have ssm.amazonaws.com in trust policy
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM Automation document "RemediateEC2" with steps using aws:executeAwsApi and aws:changeInstanceState. Execution role: MyEC2Role (this is an EC2 instance profile role, NOT an automation assume role — it does not have ssm.amazonaws.com in its trust policy). Targets via resource group rg-prod-ec2. Schema 0.3. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_AUTOMATION: RemediateEC2
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Execution role trust policy: MyEC2Role does not allow ssm.amazonaws.com to assume

eval_cases.name: SSM Automation with undefined parameter reference (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — step references {{ UndefinedParam }} which is not declared in parameters
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SSM Automation document "BadRunbook" that: 1) Uses aws:executeAwsApi to call ec2:DescribeInstances with parameter {{ UndefinedParam }}. The parameter UndefinedParam is not declared in the parameters section. 2) Uses aws:changeInstanceState. Execution role: SSMAutomationRole. Schema 0.3. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SSM_AUTOMATION: BadRunbook
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Parameter binding: step references {{ UndefinedParam }} which is not declared in parameters
